# E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700

Stock update file OLY_E_137_1700_0000_0000.BIN; the notes' addresses refer to its MN103 main program.

**Camera:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md). **Advertised version:** 1.7. **Internal build:** 1700.

**Container SHA-256:** `939260fc22b4217fce64274eb5a6707d307a499804d8a316b6b39019c4afded2`

SHA-256 of the stock update file as downloaded from OM System. Addresses for this build are in the technical reference (main CPU base and section entries).

## Technical reference

- [Space after section 10](../reference/em5-iii-1700.after-section-10.md): 32 KB of 0xFF after section 10, loaded once the section 10 end is raised.
- [Always-ready range copied by the boot stub](../reference/em5-iii-1700.always-ready-range.md): Ready before any section loads; boot guards and small stubs can live here.
- [Enter a critical section](../reference/em5-iii-1700.critical-enter.md): Returns a token; leave with the matching routine at 0x60069e5a.
- [Start the debug Wi-Fi network](../reference/em5-iii-1700.debug-wifi-start.md): Fills the Wi-Fi request block and starts the open debug network and user shell.
- [Convert an address for the image engine](../reference/em5-iii-1700.engine-address.md): Masks a CPU address into the image engine's address space.
- [Submit an image-engine job](../reference/em5-iii-1700.engine-job-submit.md): Queues a job program on the image engine for a prepared record.
- [Image-engine job setter table](../reference/em5-iii-1700.engine-setter-table.md): Per-job setter functions that write a job's parameter words, indexed by job number.
- [fclose (card file)](../reference/em5-iii-1700.fclose.md): Closes a card file.
- [Flash write guard](../reference/em5-iii-1700.flash-write-guard.md): Resets the camera on a flash write outside the allowed data windows.
- [Focus stacking lens check](../reference/em5-iii-1700.focus-stacking-lens-check.md): The function that decides whether a lens may be used for focus stacking; its per-lens flag branch is the patch point.
- [fopen (card file)](../reference/em5-iii-1700.fopen.md): Opens a file on the card.
- [fread (card file)](../reference/em5-iii-1700.fread.md): Reads from an open card file.
- [fwrite (card file)](../reference/em5-iii-1700.fwrite.md): Writes to an open card file.
- [Gap before section 1](../reference/em5-iii-1700.gap-before-section-1.md): 54 KB of 0xFF, never copied; always ready if the boot copy end is raised.
- [Show the drawn GUI layers (gpiUpdateDisplay)](../reference/em5-iii-1700.gpi-update-display.md): Commits all three GUI layers and their palettes to the display controller; the flip for double-buffered drawing.
- [Interrupt-context test](../reference/em5-iii-1700.in-interrupt.md): Returns 0 in task context and non-zero in an interrupt handler.
- [Take a lock with timeout](../reference/em5-iii-1700.lock-take.md): Stock lock take; give back with the routine at 0x6005174e.
- [Main CPU base](../reference/em5-iii-1700.main-cpu-base.md): Runtime address of block 0 (MN103 main program) offset 0.
- [Menu setting getter](../reference/em5-iii-1700.menu-setting-getter.md): Returns a setting's value by setting id; already called during boot.
- [GUI string lookup](../reference/em5-iii-1700.menu-string-lookup.md): Looks up on-screen text by string id; a hook can answer new ids from an added table.
- [Section 3 slack](../reference/em5-iii-1700.section-3-slack.md): About 26 KB of 0xFF after section 3, usable once the section end is raised.
- [Section 4 slack](../reference/em5-iii-1700.section-4-slack.md): About 100 KB of 0xFF after section 4, usable once the section end is raised.
- [Section ready bits](../reference/em5-iii-1700.section-ready-bits.md): Bit n-1 is set once section n is loaded and initialised.
- [Section ready test](../reference/em5-iii-1700.section-ready-test.md): Stock function that returns 1 when section n is ready.
- [Sensor mode request sender](../reference/em5-iii-1700.sensor-request.md): Sends the type-7 sensor mode request (exposure block and mode block).
- [Setting getter](../reference/em5-iii-1700.setting-getter.md): Stock getter for camera settings by setting id.
- [User settings image (store 50)](../reference/em5-iii-1700.settings-image.md): 256 KB RAM image of the user settings, loaded whole at boot and saved whole at power-off.
- [Settings store save](../reference/em5-iii-1700.settings-save.md): Writes a settings store to flash only when the live image differs from the saved bank.
- [Simulated key press](../reference/em5-iii-1700.simulated-key.md): Sets or clears a key-matrix bit so the UI task handles it as a real press.
- [Sleep (milliseconds)](../reference/em5-iii-1700.sleep-ms.md): Task sleep in milliseconds.
- [Shooting-state event dispatcher](../reference/em5-iii-1700.state-dispatcher.md): Walks the current state's event table and calls the matching handler.
- [No-op state event handler](../reference/em5-iii-1700.state-noop-handler.md): Stock handler that does nothing and reports the event handled.
- [Shooting state table](../reference/em5-iii-1700.state-table.md): Stock shooting-sequencer state table: 34 entries of 20 bytes, states 0 to 33.
- [Current task id](../reference/em5-iii-1700.task-id.md): Returns the id of the running task.
- [Hardware tick counter](../reference/em5-iii-1700.tick-counter.md): Free-running counter at 1 microsecond per count.
- [Create a timer](../reference/em5-iii-1700.timer-create.md): Stock timer service: one-shot or periodic callback after a number of milliseconds.
- [User shell command table](../reference/em5-iii-1700.user-shell-table.md): The 58-command table of the stock user shell (Tsk_USHL).
- [Start or stop the ARM co-processor only between shots](../reference/hazard.arm-power-mid-shot.md): Powering the ARM side on or off during a shot reset the camera.
- [Write card files with 8.3 names from cached heap buffers](../reference/hazard.card-file-names.md): Long names and uncached source buffers produced empty files.
- [Keep CPU reads of image memory below 0xc0000000](../reference/hazard.cpu-read-high-ram.md): CPU reads of the 0xc4000000 frame block rebooted the camera.
- [Check image-engine records against the bridge's limits](../reference/hazard.engine-record-refused.md): A record the bridge refuses parks the worker; the next image-engine use hangs.
- [Never write to the logical flash range](../reference/hazard.logical-flash-writes.md): Addresses from 0x40000000 up are the logical flash range.
- [Only call code in a section that has already loaded](../reference/hazard.section-load-order.md): Sections load one after another; a hook calling a later section can run before its target exists.
- [A hung task does not trigger the watchdog](../reference/hazard.task-hang-no-reset.md): The watchdog is fed by its own task, so a hang in another task leaves the camera frozen.
- [Give added shooting states a handler for every event they can receive](../reference/hazard.unhandled-state-event.md): An unhandled event prints a history dump in the sequencer task and stalls it.
